inlines.text: How 2025 Transformed AI in Healthcare — and What Practice Leaders Must be mindful of in 2026

body.text: 2025 was the year artificial intelligence in healthcare stopped being a headline — and started becoming infrastructure. Across the country, practices began moving beyond experimentation. They started embedding AI agents into the real heartbeat of operations: answering calls, managing scheduling, routing patients, and relieving staff of repetitive, high-volume tasks.
